title: docs(hits): Update documentation for the `allItems` property
body:
Seems like the `allItems` property for both template and transformData
was a copy-paste of the `item` one.

comments.body: By analyzing the blame information on this pull request, we identified @bobylito, @vvo and @Jerskouille to be potential reviewers
Oh wait, actually I'm not sure of what I wrote. Will the `transformData.allItems` only be used for the `templates.allItems` template, or will it also work for `templates.item` individually?

Just tested it. What I wrote is correct, the `item` and `allItems` templates are mutually exclusive, and the `item` and `allItems` `transformData` only apply to their respective templates.

So this can be merged.
